title: Concept: Apache Airflow interface disclosed
description: The Airflow web interface is served at this endpoint, so the workflow console that holds DAG definitions and connections is reachable.
applicability: Responses served by an Airflow web server.
risk: A reachable Airflow exposes DAG definitions, connection identifiers and manual trigger controls; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove that a job can be triggered without credentials.
